newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-REAL MADRID KEEN TO SIGN DENILSON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REAL MADRID KEEN TO SIGN DENILSON.

text.p: Spanish champions Real Madrid have offered Brazilian club Sao Paulo 2.9 billion pesetas ($20 million) for Brazilian international striker Denilson, the Spanish sports daily Marca said on Monday.
A Real Madrid spokeswoman was unable to confirm the offer but said the club would be talking to Denilson's representative Luiz Viana later this week.
Denilson, 19, attracted the attention of European clubs with his outstanding performance in Brazil's recent Copa America triumph.

He was reported on Saturday as saying he was keen to join Real but that Sao Paulo were reluctant to let him go before next year's World Cup where a good performance could significantly increase his transfer value.
Several Italian clubs are also reported to be interested in signing him.
